svg.title: Context-loading lifecycle
svg.desc: Four compact stages separate inventory and policy, exposure, runtime disclosure, and outcome. Cached or installed material is not automatically visible; inspection is not activation; named resources load only when conditions are met; and verification remains distinct from execution.

span.p:
Failure or incomplete evidence
bounded retry only

span.p:
1 · Inventory and policy
Cached → Installed → Registered → Eligible

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · Exposure
Prompt-visible or Router-retrievable
→ Retrieved candidate

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · Runtime disclosure
Inspect → Resolve → Pin and activate
→ Load named resources conditionally
